description: This PHP class 'CustomFieldService' provides methods for managing custom fields in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes functionality for generating field keys and getter/setter method names, extracting field numbers from keys, and interacting with the data access object (CustomFieldDao) to perform operations like deleting extra data and checking field usage.

classes.name: CustomFieldService
classes.description: Service class for handling operations related to custom fields in the HR system.

methods.name: getCustomFieldDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the CustomFieldDao instance.

methods.name: generateGettersByFieldNumbers
methods.description: Generates an array of getter method names corresponding to given field numbers.

methods.name: generateFieldKeyByFieldId
methods.description: Creates a custom field key string based on a field number.

methods.name: generateSetterByFieldKey
methods.description: Generates a setter method name for a given field key.

methods.name: extractFieldNumbersFromFieldKeys
methods.description: Extracts numeric field identifiers from an array of custom field keys.

methods.name: deleteRelatedEmployeeCustomFieldsExtraData
methods.description: Removes specific extra data entries from related employee custom fields, updating entries in use.

methods.name: getAllFieldsInUse
methods.description: Checks and returns a list of custom field numbers currently in use.
